result.instructions: Tools for Realtime Register, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Is example.com still available to register, and what does it cost?"; "List the domains in our account that expire in the next 60 days."; "Show the DNS records of our main domain.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Realtime Register data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run realtimeregister_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run realtimeregister_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run realtimeregister_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. realtimeregister_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: realtimeregister_check_domain
tools.title: Check a domain
tools.description: Check whether a domain name is available to register, with its price if it is premium. Check one name per call and wait at least one second before the next call (vendor acceptable use policy). Realtime Register API: GET /domains/{domainName}/check.

domainName.description: The domain name, such as example.com.

renewPrice.description: Also return the renewal price of a premium domain.

tools.name: realtimeregister_list_domains
tools.title: List domains
tools.description: List the domains in the customer account, with expiry dates, name servers and status. Use limit and offset to page through them. Realtime Register API: GET /domains/.

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging.

tools.name: realtimeregister_get_domain
tools.title: Get a domain
tools.description: Get one domain in the customer account: registrant, contacts, name servers, status, expiry and auto-renew settings. Realtime Register API: GET /domains/{domainName}.

domainName.description: The domain name, such as example.com.

tools.name: realtimeregister_get_domain_zone
tools.title: Get a domain's DNS zone
tools.description: Get the DNS zone that belongs to a domain, with its records and SOA settings. Realtime Register API: GET /domains/{domainName}/zone.

domainName.description: The domain name, such as example.com.

tools.name: realtimeregister_list_dns_zones
tools.title: List DNS zones
tools.description: List the DNS zones in the customer account. Use limit and offset to page through them. Realtime Register API: GET /dns/zones/.

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging.

tools.name: realtimeregister_get_dns_zone
tools.title: Get a DNS zone
tools.description: Get one DNS zone by id, with its records and SOA settings. Read the zone before any update. Realtime Register API: GET /dns/zones/{id}.

tools.name: realtimeregister_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List the contacts (registrant and admin records) of the customer account. Realtime Register API: GET /customers/{customer}/contacts/.

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging.

tools.name: realtimeregister_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: Get one contact by handle. Realtime Register API: GET /customers/{customer}/contacts/{handle}.

tools.name: realtimeregister_list_hosts
tools.title: List hosts
tools.description: List the host objects (name servers with glue addresses) in the customer account. Realtime Register API: GET /hosts/.

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging.

tools.name: realtimeregister_get_host
tools.title: Get a host
tools.description: Get one host object by its name, such as ns1.example.com. Realtime Register API: GET /hosts/{hostName}.

hostName.description: The host name, such as ns1.example.com.

tools.name: realtimeregister_get_credit
tools.title: Get the account credit
tools.description: Get the prepaid credit balance of the customer account. Domain orders are paid from this balance. Realtime Register API: GET /customers/{customer}/credit.

tools.name: realtimeregister_get_process
tools.title: Get a process
tools.description: Get the status of an asynchronous process, such as a domain update or a DNS zone change. Use the id from a write call's response. Realtime Register API: GET /processes/{id}.

processId.description: The process id from a write call's response.

tools.name: realtimeregister_get_tld_info
tools.title: Get TLD information
tools.description: Get the registry metadata for a TLD, such as its rules and the fields it requires. Realtime Register API: GET /tlds/{tld}/info.

tld.description: The TLD without the dot, such as com or nl.

tools.name: realtimeregister_update_dns_zone
tools.title: Update a DNS zone
tools.description: Change the SOA settings, name servers or records of a DNS zone. Read the zone first with realtimeregister_get_dns_zone and send only the fields you change. Changes reach the public internet after DNS caches expire. Send writes one at a time, at least one second apart (vendor acceptable use policy). Returns the process id to poll with realtimeregister_get_process. Realtime Register API: POST /dns/zones/{id}/update.

hostMaster.description: The hostmaster e-mail address of the zone.

expire.description: SOA expire time in seconds, from 86400 to 4838400.

ttl.description: SOA time to live in seconds, from 60 to 2419200.

items.description: The host name, such as ns1.example.com.

ns.description: The name servers for the domain, such as ns1.example.net. Up to 10.

records.description: Records to send with the update.

name.description: The full record name, such as www.example.com.

content.description: Record value, such as an IP address or a host name.

ttl.description: Time to live in seconds. Omit it to use the zone default.

prio.description: Priority. Required for MX and SRV records.
